confidence_notes: Meal and coffee estimates follow [Numbeo](https://es.numbeo.com/coste-de-vida/ciudad/Cordoba-Espana). A [local price guide](https://www.explorecordoba.com/plan/cordoba-travel-cost) informs the less certain cocktail and wine estimates, approximately 3.6 and 1.6 times the beer price. July accommodation prices are uncertain model estimates. USD anchors use November exchange rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on inland Andalusian heritage cities such as Granada, with Córdoba generally less expensive and July heat moderating overnight demand.
